tasks.label: copy-media-to-mega
tasks.command: set -e && SRC="/Users/andrealombardo/Development/Personal/TravelWebSite/assets" && DST="/Users/andrealombardo/Development/Personal/TravelWebSite/mega_upload/TravelWebsite" && cp -R "$SRC/img/thailandia/." "$DST/img-originali/thailandia/" && cp -R "$SRC/img/usa/." "$DST/img-originali/usa/" && cp -R "$SRC/img/cile/." "$DST/img-originali/cile/" && cp -R "$SRC/img/china/." "$DST/img-originali/china/" && cp -R "$SRC/img/scotland/." "$DST/img-originali/scotland/" && cp -R "$SRC/img/sri_lanka/." "$DST/img-originali/sri_lanka/" && cp -R "$SRC/img/other/." "$DST/img-originali/other/" && find "$SRC/video" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*.mp4" -exec cp {} "$DST/video-originali/other/" \; && echo "COPY_DONE"

tasks.label: generate-gallery-images-list
tasks.command:
set -e && ROOT="/Users/andrealombardo/Development/Personal/TravelWebSite" && OUT="$ROOT/assets/js/gallery-images.js" && : > "$OUT" && printf "window.travelGalleryImages = [
" >> "$OUT" && for dir in cile china scotland sri_lanka thailandia usa; do find "$ROOT/assets/img/$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -iname "*.jpg" -o -iname "*.jpeg" -o -iname "*.png" -o -iname "*.webp" -o -iname "*.avif" \) | sort | while IFS= read -r file; do rel=${file#"$ROOT/"}; printf "  { src: '%s' },
" "$rel" >> "$OUT"; done; done && printf "];
" >> "$OUT" && echo "GALLERY_IMAGES_DONE"

tasks.label: refresh-mega-media-copy
tasks.command:
set -e
ROOT="/Users/andrealombardo/Development/Personal/TravelWebSite"
DST="$ROOT/mega_upload/TravelWebsite"
mkdir -p "$DST/img-originali" "$DST/video-originali"
rsync -a --delete "$ROOT/assets/img/cile/" "$DST/img-originali/cile/"
rsync -a --delete "$ROOT/assets/img/china/" "$DST/img-originali/china/"
rsync -a --delete "$ROOT/assets/img/scotland/" "$DST/img-originali/scotland/"
rsync -a --delete "$ROOT/assets/img/sri_lanka/" "$DST/img-originali/sri_lanka/"
rsync -a --delete "$ROOT/assets/img/thailandia/" "$DST/img-originali/thailandia/"
rsync -a --delete "$ROOT/assets/img/usa/" "$DST/img-originali/usa/"
rsync -a --delete "$ROOT/assets/img/other/" "$DST/img-originali/other/"
rsync -a --delete "$ROOT/assets/video/" "$DST/video-originali/"
echo "REFRESH_MEGA_MEDIA_DONE"

tasks.command: git ls-files assets/img/cile assets/img/china assets/img/scotland assets/img/sri_lanka assets/img/thailandia assets/img/usa assets/img/other assets/video/1.mp4 assets/video/2.mp4 assets/video/3.mp4 assets/video/4.mp4 assets/video/5.mp4 assets/video/6.mp4 | sed -n '1,200p'
